detail.text: Count the delivery line before posting and compare the counted quantity (99) with both the delivery note and the purchase order (100).

Post the 99 counted pieces (not the ordered 100) and add a note about the deviation in the goods receipt.
Post the goods receipt in the WMS against the purchase order line, not against a different line.
